name: contact-faq-split
title: Contact with FAQ
description: Answer before they write: the few questions that fill your inbox in an accordion beside a short contact form.
docs: Pass faqs (a question, an answer that may hold markup, and optional keywords), onSubmit, a title, an optional description and a promise such as 'We reply within one working day.' The questions are an accordion with one open at a time; defaultOpen picks the one that starts open. While the message is typed, a hint appears after a short pause with the question that shares the most words with it ('This might answer it: Where is my order?'): words are compared by their roots, small words in stopWords are skipped, and a question's keywords catch other ways of asking. A keyword of several words ('money back') counts only when the message has all of them, and a single shared word fires the hint only when it has five letters or more and belongs to one question, so 'order' or 'back' alone stay quiet. The hint is a button that opens that answer and moves focus to its question; it is announced politely, it is offered once, and it never blocks or delays the send. Mistakes are said beside their field once the visitor has been there or tried to send, and the first one takes focus. The confirmation replaces the form and takes focus. defaultValues and defaultStatus start it filled or confirmed. labels translates every fixed word.
